import sys
from collections import Counter

def can_form_circle(numbers):
    count = Counter(numbers)
    odd_count = sum(1 for v in count.values() if v % 2 != 0)
    return odd_count <= 2

def main():
    import sys
    input = sys.stdin.read().split()
    n = int(input[0])
    numbers = list(map(int, input[1:]))
    print("YES" if can_form_circle(numbers) else "NO")

main()
